sloka: विभिन्नशिरसो भूत्वा राक्षसाः शोणितोक्षिताः ।द्रुमैः प्रव्यथिताश्चान्ये निपेतुर्धरणीतले ।। ६.५२.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: vibhinnaśiraso bhūtvā rākṣasāḥ śoṇitokṣitāḥ ।drumaiḥ pravyathitāścānye nipeturdharaṇītale ।। 6.52.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Some Rakshasas hit by trees with their heads broken, shedding blood fell on the ground.
